sectionTitle: Six years owning websites end to end.

roles.role: Web Operations Specialist · Full-Stack Web Engineer
roles.highlight: Owned customer-facing web properties. Shipped campaign launches, audited 100+ pages, and troubleshot production when DNS, SSL or a publish broke.
contributions: Managed customer-facing web properties supporting global product and campaign experiences.
Shipped updates and campaign launches through CMS and component workflows.
Built responsive experiences in React, Next.js and TypeScript.
Audited 100+ pages for CTA consistency and usability.
Applied technical SEO across crawlability, metadata and redirects.
Monitored Core Web Vitals, page speed and accessibility as release gates.
Troubleshot production issues across DNS, HTTPS and SSL certificates.
Ran service desk tickets end to end: intake, triage by business impact, escalation with reproduction steps, and resolution.
Wrote the Confluence knowledge base: troubleshooting guides, release instructions and SOPs.

roles.role: Web Content & Digital Experience Analyst · Full-Stack Web Developer
roles.highlight: Managed 175+ digital initiatives across institutional websites, built the templates they publish through, and gated every launch on accessibility and Core Web Vitals.
contributions: Managed 175+ digital initiatives across institutional websites.
Built responsive pages in HTML, CSS and JavaScript from Figma designs I also produced.
Published with governance, creating, reviewing and launching content through Cascade CMS.
Developed custom WordPress themes and plugins with caching and SEO for departmental sites.
Used GA4 and Qualtrics to monitor engagement and inform content decisions.
Implemented technical SEO across metadata, schema markup and redirects.
Applied Core Web Vitals and accessibility checks before every launch.
Automated image workflows in Python and OpenCV, covering HDR, content-aware crop and dynamic resizing, cutting manual editing time by 40%.
Ran responsive, functional, accessibility, browser and production QA before and after every release.

roles.highlight: Built patient-facing booking portals and provider search flows to WCAG/ADA standards.
contributions: Designed and developed responsive booking portals, provider search flows and service-line microsites, mobile-first.
Built front-end components such as forms, navigation and interactive cards, with real validation, states and error handling.
Implemented schema.org markup and WCAG/ADA compliance with the marketing and SEO teams.
Ran UX research using GA4, heatmaps and usability testing, iterating layouts and CTAs on the appointment funnel.
Optimised page performance, load times and cross-browser compatibility.

roles.highlight: Corporate site, investor pages and project showcase microsites, built responsive from scratch.
contributions: Designed and launched corporate layouts, investor pages and project showcase microsites.
Built responsive front-end interfaces in HTML5, CSS3 and JavaScript for cross-browser and multi-device support.
Built interactive UI components: sliders, forms, navigation and project galleries.
Integrated SEO best practice, analytics tracking and structured data markup.
Established scalable templates for later digital work.
